title: Run the game once, unchanged
body:
First, make sure your copy builds and its quick tests pass:

```sh
npm ci && node tools/kit.mjs check
```

It worked if it ends with `fail 0`.

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: Start the MARBLE RUN minigame
check: npm run build && node --test test/mg-marbles.test.mjs test/party.test.mjs
body:
A minigame is one short round. This writes one that already plays and adds it to Party:

```sh
node tools/new-mg.mjs marbles mb "MARBLE RUN"
```

Check:

```sh
npm run build && node --test test/mg-marbles.test.mjs test/party.test.mjs
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: A twisty track with edges
body:
Swap the sumo ring for a track that winds downhill, with edges a marble can fall off. One bend first.

Check:

```sh
npm run build && node --test test/mg-marbles.test.mjs
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: Checkpoints, and first to the bottom wins
body:
A marble that falls off comes back at its last checkpoint. The first one to the bottom wins the round.

Check:

```sh
npm run build && node --test test/mg-marbles.test.mjs
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: See it on your page
body:
Turn on your page once: Settings > Pages > Source: GitHub Actions. Then `client/party.html?mg=30` on your page plays MARBLE RUN.

Check that the site builds:

```sh
npm run build && node tools/site.mjs
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.
